title.rendered: Best card games for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
Card games are one of the most versatile and engaging ways to pass the time and have fun. They’re also among the best games to play with friends, whether at home or on a trip. While there are some age-old ones, like poker or solitaire, there are many new kinds, too. Check out the full range of them all with these best card games for iPhone and iPad.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Editor's Choice: UNO!
  • 2. Solitaire
  • 3. Spades +
  • 4. Heads Up! – Trivia on the go
  • 5. Zynga Poker – Texas Holdem
  • 6. Hearthstone
  • 7. GWENT The Witcher Card Game
  • 8. Card ▻ Games
  • 9. Pinochle
  • 10. Card Party
  • Bonus: Solitaired – Online card games to play on iPhone

1. Editor’s Choice: UNO!

This family-friendly card game never gets old. Whether you play it at home or when on the move, it’s always bound to be fun. It’s easy yet ever so competitive to keep everyone engaged for hours.

You can stick to the time-tested gameplay in Classic Mode or let the app recommend a new innovative mode to challenge you. There’s even a fun 2v2 Mode that’s a unique way to team up and strategies with a partner.

Price: Free (In-app Purchases start from $1.99)

Download

2. Solitaire

Here’s another classic card game that’s been made so much better. It’s easy and addictive to play. Plus, it gives you the chance to earn crowns and trophies by solving a unique challenge every day.

You can also customize your deck and background for a personal touch. Have better chances of winning and improve your strategy with the ability to undo unlimited moves. There’s even a Hint option to help you out when needed.

Price: Free

Download

3. Spades +

If you’re a fan of playing Spades with physical cards, you should try this live online multiplayer version. It boasts lots of players around the world and smart AI opponents to challenge your skills.

It has a realistic look and feel, offering both easy and hard achievements to unlock. It also saves your game automatically, and there’s a simple tutorial to help out new players.

Price: Free (In-app Purchases start from $0.99)

Download

4. Heads Up! – Trivia on the go

This is ta wild card game for iPhone and iPad created by Ellen Degeneres. It involves picking a category and then trying to guess the words or phrases depending on what your friends say about it.

Some of the categories include Harry Potter, Friends, and Marvel, and you can even create your own. It’s fast-paced and fun, making it perfect for any game night with loved ones. You can even record and share videos of the hilarious gameplay.

Price: $1.99

Download

5. Zynga Poker – Texas Holdem

Enjoy one of the most popular online poker games that include Texas Hold’em, as well as incredibly competitive tournaments. This app boasts more players, more tables, more tournaments, and, of course, more jackpots!

You will get a welcome bonus of 60,000 free chips, and it plays out like a real-life experience. Choose from traditional 9-person tables or join the new 5-person tables for faster play.

Price: Free (In-app Purchases start from $0.99)

Download

6. Hearthstone

Here’s an excellent collectible card game from the studio behind World of Warcraft. It’s all about collecting powerful cards to create decks while you summon minions and sling spells to seize control of an ever-shifting battleground.

Your challenge is to employ a masterful strategy to defeat anyone who dares to challenge you. You’ll have a blast dulling your way through a whimsical world of wits and luck, with the possibility of devastating outcomes with each card you play.

Price: Free (In-app Purchases start from $1.99)

Download

7. GWENT The Witcher Card Game

Check out this deck-building card game based on the Witcher fantasy novels and video game franchise. It’s easy to learn yet offers deeper challenges that’ll keep you hooked.

The cards and the game board come to life with cool animations of characters swinging weapons, flinging spells, and battling beasts. Get ready to be immersed in a world of strategic possibilities as you work to defeat your enemies.

Price: Free (In-app Purchases start from $1.99)

Download

8. Card ▻ Games

Here’s a bunch of solitaire card games in one. It includes the classic Klondike solitaire, spider solitaire, and Freecell solitaire with amazing graphics and ease of use while still being challenging.

The extra-large card symbols make it easy on the eyes, so you don’t feel strained after playing. There’s also a Smart Point System and multiple levels of difficulty according to your skills.

Price: Free

Download

9. Pinochle

This card game is played with a 48- or 80-card deck of 9s, 10s, jacks, queens, kings, and aces. The gameplay is all about repeating the bidding sequence, with players winning points by melding various card combinations and taking tricks.

You can choose to play the single or double-deck with configurable options. You team up with a computer partner called North and two computer opponents called East and West. The app is frequently updated to get better and keep you entertained.

Price: Free

Download

10. Card Party

Unleash the fun with this action-packed card game that you can play with friends or others around the world. Take the challenge to unlock ten special cards like Dice, Bingo, and Wizard.

The first player has to match the card in the discard pile by number or color. Or, the player can throw a special card or else pick one from the deck. You can earn coins to level up, and the colorful graphics and sound only add to the experience.

Price: Free (In-app Purchases start from $0.99)

Download

Bonus: Solitaired – Online card games to play on iPhone

Want the fun of playing card games on your iPhone but don’t want to burden the storage with an app? Easy-peasy, try solitaired.com, playsolitaire.io and play over 500 card games from classic Solitaire, Freecell, Hearts, and more.

While it is not compulsory to log in, you can do so to keep track of your achievements and get ranked amongst other card enthusiasts on the leaderboard. You can also add your favorite game’s webpage on your iPhone screen and access it in just one click.

I am interlinking two of my favorite classic card games; enjoy!

Play online: Spades | Spider Solitaire 

Summing Up 

Have you tried your hand at any of these card games on your iPhone and iPad? Let us know your favorite in the comments. And don’t forget to enhance the fun with the best puzzle games, too.

You may also like to read these:

  • Multiplayer Games for iPhone and iPad
  • Two-Player Games For iPhone and iPad
  • Escape Games for iPhone
  • Adventure Games for iPhone and iPad

title.rendered: Steam not opening on Mac? 13 Solutions to fix it!

content.rendered:
It’s frustrating when you wish to play games on your Mac, but the Steam app is not opening or fails to work. Several system glitches can cause Steam to keep crashing on macOS Sonoma. But don’t worry! You can quickly fix the issue. Here, I’ve compiled a list of solutions for Steam not responding on your Mac. Let’s get started!

  1. Check Steam server status
  2. Restart the Mac to fix Steam
  3. Force quit and relaunch Steam
  4. Check the Mac’s date and time settings
  5. Grant Accessibility Permissions to Steam on Mac
  6. Ensure Mac has sufficient RAM
  7. Ensure Mac has enough storage
  8. Check for Steam and macOS updates
  9. Delete Steam cache files on Mac
  10. Delete Steam preferences
  11. Opt out of Steam beta updates
  12. Reset SMC and NVRAM
  13. Delete and reinstall Steam on Mac

1. Check Steam server status

If you’re having unexpected issues with Steam, it could be due to a server-related error. Steam servers may be experiencing downtime or temporary overload, causing the service to malfunction for users. Before moving on to other solutions, you should check Steam’s server status on steamstat.us.

If the Steam servers face issues, wait until they are back online. Once the servers are up, Steam should function normally without further intervention.

2. Restart the Mac to fix Steam

Restarting your Mac can often resolve minor glitches that may cause Steam to crash or not open. This feature clears the system memory, closes background tasks, and refreshes the system. So, any underlying issues that may interfere with Steam’s operation are fixed.

To restart your Mac, click the Apple logo () on the menu bar → Select Restart. Once the Mac starts, relaunch Steam to see if the issue is fixed.

3. Force quit and relaunch Steam

If Steam doesn’t work on your Mac, simply force quitting and relaunching the app can help resolve the issue.

  1. Click the Apple logo () on the menu bar → Select Force Quit.
    You can also use the Command + Option + Esc keyboard shortcut.

    ‍
    ‍ 
  2. Select Steam from the currently open apps → Click Force Quit.


    ‍ 
  3. Then, relaunch Steam and check if the issues are fixed.

4. Check the Mac’s date and time settings

Steam relies on accurate date and time settings to communicate with its servers. If your Mac’s date and time are inaccurate, it can cause Steam to not work. To ensure this isn’t the case, verify the accuracy of your date and time settings.

  1. Click the Apple logo () in the menu bar → Select System Settings.


    ‍ 
  2. Click General from the sidebar → Select Date & Time.

  3. Toggle on Set date and time automatically.

5. Grant Accessibility Permissions to Steam on Mac

Steam requires Accessibility Permissions to perform certain functions, like displaying overlays over game windows or detecting game controllers. If Steam is not opening on your Mac, it might be because Steam doesn’t have the necessary Accessibility Permissions.

  1. Click the Apple logo → Select System Settings.
  2. Click Privacy & Security from the sidebar → Select Accessibility.

  3. Click the plus button (+) under the list of allowed apps.

  4. Go to Applications → Select Steam → Click Open.

6. Ensure Mac has sufficient RAM

Steam is a pretty demanding app that requires a significant amount of RAM to run. If Steam keeps crashing or isn’t responding on your Mac, you must check your current memory usage and close unnecessary processes to free the RAM.

  1. Open Activity Monitor on your Mac using Spotlight or Launchpad.
  2. Navigate to the Memory tab → Check the RAM usage at the bottom.

  3. Select the unused apps → Click the x icon to close them.

7. Ensure Mac has enough storage

Steam needs adequate storage space to install and run games smoothly. If your Mac’s storage is running low or near capacity, Steam might encounter issues due to insufficient disk space. Hence, you must ensure that your Mac has enough storage capacity.

  1. Click the  Apple logo in the menu bar → Select System Settings.


    ‍ 
  2. Click General from the sidebar → Select Storage.


    ‍ 
  3. Check if your Mac has sufficient disk space to run Steam.

If your Mac is running low on storage, you may refer to our step-by-step guide to free up space on your Mac. Once sufficient storage is available on your Mac, check if Steam works correctly.

8. Check for Steam and macOS updates

An outdated Steam version or macOS can lead to app crashing issues. So, keep them updated to prevent compatibility issues and resolve any potential bugs.

To install the latest version of Steam, you may follow these steps:

  1. Open the Steam client/app on your Mac.
  2. Click Steam on the Menu bar → Select Check For Updates.

To install the latest version of macOS, you may follow these steps:

  1. Navigate to System Settings → General → Software update.


    ‍ 
  2. Click Update Now if a new macOS update is available.

9. Delete Steam cache files on Mac

Corrupted cache files can sometimes prevent Steam from opening or working on your Mac. Deleting these files forces Steam to rebuild its cache, potentially eliminating corrupt data.

  1. Open Finder on your Mac → Click Go from the Menu bar.
  2. Hold the Option Key to reveal more options → Select Library.


    ‍ 
  3. Now, navigate to Application Support → Steam.


    ‍ 
  4. Right-click on the appcache folder → Select Move to Bin.

If deleting the cache folder didn’t fix the issue, you may delete the Steam Download Cache as shown in these steps:

  1. Open the Steam client/app on your Mac.
  2. Click Steam on the Menu bar → Select Preferences.


    ‍ 
  3. Select Downloads from the sidebar → Click Clear Cache → Confirm.

10. Delete Steam preferences

Glitches in Steam preference files can also cause it to experience crashes or startup problems. Deleting these files will reset the preferences to default settings, fixing any underlying issues.

  1. Open Finder → Click Go → Go to Folder from the Menu bar.
  2. Enter Library/Application Support/
  3. Select the Steam folder.
  4. Right-click the steam .plist file → Select Move to Bin.

11. Opt out of Steam beta updates

If Steam is not working after the update, opting out of the beta version may resolve the issue. Beta updates are pre-release versions of Steam that may contain unfavorable bugs. By opting out, you can ensure that you’re running a stable version of Steam, which is less likely to cause issues.

  1. Open the Steam client/app on your Mac.
  2. Click Steam on the Menu bar → Select Preferences.


    ‍ 
  3. Select Interface from the left sidebar.
  4. Click Client Beta Participation drop-down → Select No beta chosen.

12. Reset SMC and NVRAM

The NVRAM (Non-Volatile Random Access Memory) and the SMC (System Management Controller) are physical chips on the Mac that store various settings and control essential functions. Resetting these components can sometimes fix issues related to many pre-installed and third-party apps.

If you don’t know how to do this, you should refer to our guide on how to reset NVRAM on Mac, followed by our guide on how to reset SMC on Mac.

13. Delete and reinstall Steam on Mac

If you cannot fix Steam-related issues on your Mac after applying the previous solutions, deleting and reinstalling the app may help. This method will remove any corrupted or missing files that might be causing the issue and ensure that you have the latest version of the app.

  1. Open Finder on your Mac → Select Applications from the sidebar.
  2. Right-click Steam → Select Move to Bin.


    ‍ 
  3. Reinstall Steam from its official website and check if the issue is fixed.

Wrapping up…

Issues with Steam are chaotic, especially when you’re eager to dive into your favorite games. Fortunately, by following the troubleshooting steps in this guide, you should be able to identify and fix the underlying cause of the issue and get back to playing your games.

However, if Steam is still crashing or won’t open on your Mac, please drop a comment below detailing your error. We’ll do our best to assist you further and get Steam working smoothly on your Mac.

title.rendered: Best guitar apps for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
iPhone is a valuable gadget not just for audiophiles but also for people involved in creating music. Whether you’re learning guitar or want to play tabs and chords for your favorite songs, these best iPhone and iPad apps designed for both pro and beginner guitarists can be enormously helpful.

You can customize these guitar simulator apps to deliver the desired result. Jam along with your favorite songs from top artists to match the speed. Make the best use of the multiple guitar-playing modes to bolster your skill. Let’s dive ahead to read what more these apps have in store and pick a fantastic guitar simulator app for your iOS device!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Gibson – Editor’s Choice
  • 2. Ultimate Guitar: Chords & Tabs
  • 3. GuitarTuna – Chords, Tuner, Songs
  • 4. Guitar: tabs, chords & games
  • 5. Coach Guitar Lessons Tabs Pro
  • 6. Yousician – Your Music Teacher
  • 7. The Guitar with Songs
  • 8. Fretonomy – Learn Fretboard
  • 9. GuitarToolkit – tuner, metronome, chords & scales
  • 10. Steel Guitar

1. Gibson – Editor’s Choice

For all those searching for the right app to learn guitar, here’s Gibson. The UI will assure you this is the right place to learn guitar. In addition, it offers a comprehensive and immersive learning experience for guitarists of all levels.

You’ll get step-by-step guidance from some of the world’s best guitarists and receive real-time feedback on every note you play. Do note that the classes are pre-recorded, but you’ll receive feedback thanks to the advanced AI it is using. You’ll also get additional support from the training calendar and tuner that helps to track your progress.

I liked the app’s huge catalog of songs and interactive lessons. The built-in digital amplifier lets you jam along with tracks and record them. However, a few more features could have been added to the free version to tempt users into buying the premium version.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $19.99)
Download

2. Ultimate Guitar: Chords & Tabs

“Ultimate” is the word! The app has an extensive collection of more than 1,100,000 tabs and chords with lyrics to help you learn to play solos and riffs. Even better, every tab consists of multiple instrument tracks such as bass, guitar, drums, etc. There is also loop and tempo control to let you fine-tune music in a better way.

It comes with chords, notes, guitar scores and lyrics for over 500,000 songs. You can even enjoy the playback in offline mode once you have added tabs as a favorite.

Price: Free
Download

3. GuitarTuna – Chords, Tuner, Songs

GuitarTuna is one of the finest tuners for guitar, ukulele, bass, and other famous instruments. The app works with electric and acoustic guitars as well as other string instruments. As per your need, you can set at any tempo. It allows you to adjust the beat manually or set it at your preferred speed. More than 100 tunings like 12-string, 7-string, and drop-D are readied to improve your skill.

Price: Free
Download

4. Guitar: tabs, chords & games

When learning becomes fun, you never seem to get enough of your lesson. And what this app does is make your guitar learning a great experience.

You have access to a vast number of songs with lessons. So, you can explore the entire collection and pick out the ones that sound exciting.

From classical and acoustic to electric, it’s got 12 guitar types to entertain you. Plus, the app keeps adding new goodies from time to time. As a result, the catalog always has something cool to try.

Price: Free
Download

5. Coach Guitar Lessons Tabs Pro

If you are willing to master your hands right from scratch, this app could be a much better pick. You can watch videos and take the help of an animated fretboard to learn how to play songs on an acoustic guitar.

With a massive catalog of songs, you can pick out the songs and practice. The slow motion and loop video never let the joy run away. Moreover, the guitar tuner boasts 80 tunings so you have plenty of tools for experimentation.

Price: Free
Download

6. Yousician – Your Music Teacher

When you have the guidance of a personal tutor, learning music becomes a lot easier. With the right tips, they help you learn faster. Well, this app tries to do just that.

But unlike many of its counterparts, Yousician is much more than just a simple guitar app. I mean, you can get the most out of it by learning guitar, singing, ukulele, bass, and piano. Whether you are a newbie, advanced learner, professional or even a music teacher, you will find this app really handy.

Featuring more than 1500 exercises with hundreds of videos, the app lets you learn music with fun. Bear in mind you will have to subscribe to the premium version of Yousician if you want to take full advantage of all of its goodies.

Price: Free/One instrument monthly plan comes at $19.99
Download

7. The Guitar with Songs

The specialty of this app is authentic strumming and fretting. It has a large collection of 1200 songs which you will thoroughly enjoy tuning along. Whether you want to play rock, pop, or an alternative to country, reggae or TV/movie themes, it has got everything to keep you entertained.

As new songs are added every week, you will always have something nice to play. Handy features like the 24-fret guitar with multi-touch, adjustable metronome and 4-8 string support, resizable frets and resizable string make this app a real deal.

Price: Free
Download

8. Fretonomy – Learn Fretboard

If you have recently started learning Guitar, Fret Trainer is the app you should try. It is an educational app to learn notes and chords and then try it practically on your Guitar. The best part about the app is that it shows you notes and chords in the form of a game, which doesn’t bore you for a long time.

The app offers six different instruments, and you can choose the one you use. You’ll receive notes and chords based on your instrument. The app is free for basic use, but to unlock other instruments and advanced features, you will have to purchase it.

Price: Free with optional in-app purchase
Download

9. GuitarToolkit – tuner, metronome, chords & scales

“Guitar Toolkit” is a powerful app with multiple useful guitar tools like tuners, arpeggios, metronomes, scales, and chords. It’s compatible with all the instruments, including 6, 7, and 12-string guitars and 4, 5, and 6-string bass.

The huge library with more than 2,000,000 chords and scales may never let you run out of options. You can upgrade the app to use important features like the option for drum pattern creation and editing, chord sheet creation, and editing.

Price: $2.99
Download

10. Steel Guitar

What makes “Steel Guitar” a top bet is the adorable collection of high-quality guitars, real-time effects, and amp processing. You can use the ten superior guitars, 16 instant effects, and eight amps to have better control over your tone.

To have a real pedal steel sound, you have the option to use MIDI or the accelerometer to have perfect control over the string-bending pedals. There is also a left-handed mode to let you master the guitar. You can save unlimited numbers of presets and export/import them with ease.

Price: $0.99
Download

Signing Off

Now, make the utmost use of these fantastic guitar apps to improve your skills and be a much better guitarist. These apps can be enormously helpful in providing both the fun and needed guidance to excel.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: Best iPhone apps you must use in 2026

content.rendered:
It’s been years since Apple revolutionized the tech world with the tagline, “There’s an app for that.” And today, this rings more accurate with the ever-expanding capabilities of apps. If you want a comprehensive overview of which app is worth getting, here are our suggestions for the best iPhone apps covering different categories and serving unique purposes. Take a look!

Photo and Video apps

Capture and edit your memories with the best photo and video apps for iPhone.

1. PicMerger Edit Pics & Collages – Editor’s choice

For social media freaks like me, photo editing apps are essential. I heavily rely on the PicMerger app on a daily basis as it fulfills all my needs for picture editing. You can collage photos using 200+ built-in templates and frames, add custom font texts and watermarks, apply textured borders, decorate them with 100 custom stickers, etc.

Though the built-in layouts are good. Additionally, you may merge your photos or screenshots side by side without making a collage. Besides, it allows you to edit your images, crop them to specific dimensions, and export them in high quality.

Pros

  • Merge photos side by side
  • Easy to use
  • Unlimited storage to save edited photos

Cons

  • The free version is limited

Price: Free

Download

2. Picsart AI – Decorate with stickers, frames, GIFs

Picsart gives wings to your creativity. This multipurpose app houses the best-in-class features to help you create those Insta-worthy pictures, videos, and collages. Designed for beginners and experts, Picsart features a pool of 60M+ fancy stickers, stylish frames, layouts, GIFs, color palettes, drawing tools, filters, and more.   

Alongside, Picsart has a dedicated AI Image Generator that enhances your pictures/videos without much effort. The tool creates unique images and GIFs automatically in seconds. Plus, you can upload your photos and create customized avatars using the AI Avatar feature. Sounds fun! 

Pros

  • Simple UI with multiple features 
  • AI-assisted editing tools 
  • Helps create AI avatar  

Cons

  • Frequent crashes

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $4.99) 

Download  

3. Remini – Powerful AI photo editor for iPhone

Powered by AI, Remini is one of the best photo and video editing apps for iPhone users. Its innovative technology transforms your old, blurry photographs into high-definition pictures that you can share on your socials. You can restore your precious vintage photos that have lost their charm but are an inevitable part of your memories.   

With the Remini app on your iPhone, you never have to worry about your look when clicking pictures. The powerful AI ensures flawless clicks, even without the required lighting or background setup.  

Pros

  • Restores vintage, old, blurry pictures 
  • Works with AI 
  • Created HD images 
  • Multiple editing tools 

Cons

  • Ads in the free version

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99) 

Download  

4. InShot – Best video editor for beginners  

Here’s a video editing app that makes it easy to create engaging video stories in just a few minutes. InShot not only lets you edit videos but also pictures and lets you create collages. It allows you to combine multiple videos at a time. The merging speed can be slow, though. 

Its video editor brings many features. For instance, you can trim, cut, or split videos easily. And adding music or a voice-over to your video is easy. It also lets you add stickers to videos, and if you want to animate stickers, there’s an edit section offering various effects, including background blurring. 

Pros

  • Make video collages 
  • Add voice effects 
  • Smooth slow motion and transitions 

Cons

  • The free version leaves a watermark

Price: Free (In-app purchases start from $1.99) 

Download  

Communication apps

The main purpose of using an iPhone is to communicate, right? So, we’ll kick off this discussion with the best non-native iOS apps for communication.

5. Gmail – Most popular email for iPhone

Think communication; think Gmail. This user-friendly email service has been at the forefront for over a decade to ensure seamless personal and professional collaborations. Its unparalleled security, integration with the Google ecosystem, and multipurpose features make it an ideal pick for iPhone users. In the free version, Gmail offers up to 15GB of storage space to users.

The app lets you organize, schedule, and respond to emails instantly at zero cost. Apart from emails, Gmail allows you to create and interact with your peer groups through services like Google Chat and Spaces. Plus, you can make and attend video calls using your Gmail ID on Google Meet. If you love to multitask, Gmail is the ideal accomplice in your endeavors. 

Pros

  • Instant messages and calls 
  • End-to-end encryption  
  • Free of cost 

Cons

  •   Security concerns

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99) 

Download

6. WhatsApp – Best free messaging app for iPhone

Designed by Meta, WhatsApp shines as one of the most popular messaging and calling apps globally. The portal features a simple interface that lets you send and receive texts, pictures, videos, GIFs, files, documents, contacts, and more. There is also a separate status section on WhatsApp for sharing pictures with a deadline of 24 hours.

By leveraging the power of end-to-end encryption, WhatsApp keeps your conversations safe from third-party intrusions. The platform is completely free to use and is one of the best alternatives to iMessage on your iPhone. Furthermore, you can even make instant online transactions with the WhatsApp Pay feature.   

Pros

  • Instant messages and calls 
  • End-to-end encryption  
  • Free of cost 

Cons

  •   Security concerns

Price: Free  

Download  

7. Telegram – Cloud service for communication

Telegram is a trusted cloud-based messaging, calling, and content-sharing app. With end-to-end encryption, Telegram is a perfect place for holding big collaborations. Thanks to its ability to help hold group chats with up to 200,000 members and create personal channels with unlimited subscribers. Moreover, Telegram has smart bots to automate certain specific tasks, saving you tonnes of effort.   

Regarding data sharing, Telegram allows its users to share large videos and documents of up to 2 GB. You can even edit your pictures and videos and add emojis and GIFs for a more personalized look. Every conversation you make on Telegram stays on its cloud, saving your iPhone from data dump. The seamless interface paired with intuitive filters makes Telegram a worthy pick.  

Pros

  • Instant messages and calls 
  • End-to-end encryption  
  • Free of cost 

Cons

  •   Security concerns

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $4.99) 

Download  

8. Microsoft Outlook – Email service and work planner

Integrated with the Microsoft 365 suite, Outlook is a comprehensive email service for building personal and professional connections. However, the scope of the portal is not limited to just email. You can use Outlook for managing calendars and contacts, creating to-do lists and notes, etc. The portal vouches to ensure top-notch data security and privacy for users. 

Outlook makes your work easy with features like conversation threading, search and filtering, rules, and more. In addition, the built-in Calendar feature helps you manage your appointments and meetings. The Contacts feature lets you store all your contacts, making it easy to send emails or schedule meetings. Further, Outlook Tasks and Notes features ensure vital task planning. 

Pros

  • Instant messages and calls 
  • End-to-end encryption  
  • Free of cost 

Cons

  •   Security concerns

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99) 

Download  

Artificial Intelligence (AI) apps

Enhance your productivity, creativity, and personal well-being with these innovative AI-powered iOS apps.

9. ChatGPT – Your personal virtual assistant 

ChatGPT is a powerful virtual writing assistant that performs a plethora of tasks on your instructions. The list can include idea generation, text creation, language translation, creative writing, and question answering. One of the best features of ChatGPT is its ability to generate human-like responses to all your requests.  

Once you create your ChatGPT account, you can enter the prompts in its search box and wait for the AI to feed you with answers within seconds. The app is helpful for content writers, students, professionals, creators, etc. You can try the Premium version of ChatGPT for more advanced features on your mobile app or web portal.  

Pros

  • Diverse content library 
  • Subtitles facility 
  • Multiple plans to choose from 
  • Regularly updated episodes 

Cons

  • No free access

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $19.99) 

Download  

10. Lensa AI – Create magical avatars for fun 

Lensa AI is for anyone who loves going bold in their selfie game. This simple yet efficient app lets you quit the traditional editing tools to decorate your selfies in a unique way you won’t find anywhere else. Get rid of the wrinkles, eye bags, pimples, scars, and everything that makes you conscious about your beautiful self.   

One of the main features of the app is the Magic Avatars. The app analyzes your real pictures to create multiple versions of your digital avatar using a combination of elements from the real and AI worlds. Eventually, you can pick your favorite things from the various versions and pile them together to create a stunning final image.  

Pros

  • Diverse content library 
  • Subtitles facility 
  • Multiple plans to choose from 
  • Regularly updated episodes 

Cons

  • No free access

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99) 

Download

Education apps

Empower your learning with these top-rated educational apps tailored to elevate your knowledge and skills.

12. Duolingo – Learn a new language every day

Planning to learn a new language but have no time? Hop on to the Duolingo app. Recognized as a powerful language-learning app, Duolingo unlocks a fun way to learn 40+ global languages with ease. The stack of bite-sized lessons helps you sharpen your basics related to the core vocabulary and grammar of the language you are trying to learn.

With fun characters and game activities, Duolingo nurtures your speaking, reading, listening, and writing skills. If you like Duolingo, you will also like our other education apps for iPhone listed in this guide.

Pros

  • Intuitive interface 
  • 40+ languages  
  • Fun and bite-sized lessons 

Cons

  •   No cons found

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99) 

Download  

13. Lingvano – Sign language made easy

Lingvano is a simple yet efficient app to learn sign language. The portal relies on intuitive modules to develop your everyday communication skills. However, learning the language can be overwhelming. This is why Lingvano has a vocabulary trainer that reinforces your memory and helps your brain absorb the collected information. Further, the ASL dictionary lets you find detailed information about specific signs or sentences.   

Pros

  • Small and intuitive lessons 
  • ASL dictionary access 
  • In-app vocabulary trainer 

Cons

  • No feedback option
  • Expensive

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $17.99) 

Download  

14. Flipboard – Stories you must know

Stay updated about the latest stories worldwide with the Flipboard app on your iPhone. The portal gives you a one-tap access to thousands of national and international stories from leading publishers like The New York Times, The Atlantic, TIME, etc. With easy filters, you can create a personalized news feed that shows topics of your interests.   

Once you have your feed, you can pick your favorite stories and share them on your personal Flipboard Magazine. You also get editor-created collections like The Daily Edition, The Tech Digest, The Tastiest, and more. 

Pros

  • Top publishers included 
  • Multiple fields of interest 
  • Easy personalization 

Cons

  • Less intuitive

Price: Free  

Download 

Entertainment apps

From streaming your favorite shows to enjoying movie nights, these iPhone apps have something for everyone.

15. Netflix – Stream your favorites

Netflix and chill! A tagline that forms the heartline of our weekends. After all, where else will you get thousands of movies, series, Originals, games, and documentaries to match your vibes? With subtitles, the streaming service allows you to enjoy the most celebrated works from across the globe without language restrictions.  

The simple in-app navigation helps you search your favorites through the content-specific categories. In addition, you can create separate accounts for your family and friends under a single subscription based on the plan you take. Though unlike other streaming apps, Netflix doesn’t offer free or trial account access to its users. 

Pros

  • Diverse content library 
  • Subtitles facility 
  • Multiple plans to choose from 
  • Regularly updated episodes 

Cons

  • No free access

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $11.99) 

Download  

16. Spotify – Musical treats on your iPhone

In the pool of music streaming apps, Spotify is a people’s favorite. The never-ending content library of this superior app includes millions of songs, albums, and original podcasts for every music lover to cherish. Whether you are looking for the iconic 90s songs or the latest Billboard topper of Taylor Swift- Spotify gives it all in a single tap.

You can create your own liked songs playlists or let Spotify do it for you. The app analyzes your listening choices to curate personalized daily mixes you might like. Just tap and play. In addition, you can bookmark songs, play them on a loop, or do karaoke with the lyrics. Further, Spotify lets you download songs and play them offline anytime. You can even listen to audiobooks here.

Pros

  • Global song library 
  • Supports offline mode 
  • Has a free version 
  • Auto-generated playlists 

Cons

  • Limited features in the free version

Price: Free  

Download  

17. Twitch – Play, explore, and share

Follow your passion for live streaming with Twitch. This Amazon-owned portal is the hottest destination for gamers who want to indulge in real-time intense gaming sessions with their supporters rooting for them. When you choose Twitch, you get a super-fluid interface, easy controls, and several thriving communities to seek inspiration. Just join and enjoy live streams.   

Unlike the popular opinion, Twitch is not limited to only gaming. Here, you can join communities exploring different fields of interest like food, lifestyle, fashion, motivation, art, investment, and more. You can search for your favorite genre and follow streamers from the same field. The live chat feature lets you interact with them on vlogs and streams.   

Pros

  • Multiple communities  
  • Free games and items for subscribers 
  • Live chat during streams  

Cons

  • Frequent ads

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99) 

Download  

18. Overcast – Podcasts in your pockets  

Overcast is a simple podcast player that unlocks the treasure of insightful audio for your ears, mind, and soul. Featuring an intuitive UI, this free-to-download app is home to a massive library of renowned podcast shows. The collection includes audio from different genres, such as love, motivation, horror, comedy, science, and more.   

Regarding features, Overcast lets you control the volume and speed of the podcast you are playing on the portal. In addition, you can create your playlists, customize them with filters, and enhance your experience. The app works offline, houses a sleep timer, and is compatible with Apple Watch. There is something special for every listener. 

Pros

  • Easy search and navigation 
  • Audio controls  
  • Sends notifications for updates 

Cons

  • No cons found 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $9.99) 

Download  

19. Pandora: Music and Podcasts – Everything you love

Pandora is one of the top iPhone apps for music lovers. It boasts a diverse collection of songs and podcasts that can effortlessly cater to the whims of every audiophile. Simply search your preferred song title, artist, or genre and watch it appear on your screen in seconds.  

You can create your playlists and play them anytime, online or offline. Moreover, Pandora’s algorithm suggests songs based on your streaming patterns, a handy fix when you run out of options. The app also displays the latest information about the upcoming tours of your favorite artists and gives easy access to their tickets.  

Pros

  • Smooth navigation 
  • Big content library 
  • Shows upcoming tour information 

Cons

  •       Frequent ads 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $3.99)

Download  

Social media apps

Stay connected with your friends, family, and the world around you with these top-rated social media apps for iPhone.

20. Instagram – Create memories through pictures

With Instagram, you are always connected. The photo-sharing app lets you share your precious moments with your favorite people through pictures and be a part of their experiences with their shared collections. Apart from this, Instagram enables you to hold live sessions, start a question-and-answer quiz, share polls, and so much more. Plus, the quirky filter collection ensures you get the best clicks in seconds.  

Instagram Reels is yet another exciting feature offered by the social media platform. Reels are short video clips where you get the freedom to do anything and everything that you want. Be a dancing diva or a mimic- your choice. Plus, Instagram lets you connect to your family and friends through private or group chats.  

Pros

  • Instant messages and calls 
  • End-to-end encryption  
  • Free of cost 

Cons

  •   Security concerns   

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99) 

Download  

21. Snapchat – Create streaks with friends

Like Instagram, Snapchat lets you click pictures, record videos, and share them with your friends instantly. The app has plenty of fun, interactive filters to transform your regular images into perfect clicks for social media portals. You can add stories, hold conversations in the Chat section, or explore new content in the Discover feed.   

Regarding safety, Snapchat ensures that your chats can only be viewed by the person you intend to send to. Your conversations disappear after some time, leaving no room for intrusions. Further, you can use the in-app My AI chatbot to perform various tasks, answer questions, and seek recommendations when needed.  

Pros

  • Instant messages and calls 
  • End-to-end encryption  
  • Free of cost 

Cons

  •   Security concerns

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.49)  

Download 

Finance apps

Manage your money easily and efficiently using the best finance apps for iPhone, designed to keep track of your spending, investments, and overall financial health.

22. Groupon – Boost savings with cool deals

Promising to give 70% savings, Groupon is a cool way to shop. This user-friendly app informs you about thousands of pocket-friendly deals lying close to you that can otherwise go unnoticed by you. Here, you can feast on several never-seen-before discount bargains on your favorite eateries, spas, items, travel, and things to do. 

The portal sends you regular promo codes and special savings alerts on your iPhone so you never miss the good things in life. Plus, you can quickly redeem these deals directly from your smartphone; no printed receipts are required. Simply use Apple Pay and grab the deals instantly. 

Pros

  • Instant messages and calls 
  • End-to-end encryption  
  • Free of cost 

Cons

  • Security concerns 

Price: Free  

Download  

23. Venmo – Fuss-free shared expenses

Looking for a reliable mobile payment service? Meet Venmo. The powerful mobile payment app that lets you send and receive money from friends and family securely. Its innovative technology makes it an ideal pick for splitting bills, sending money as gifts, or reimbursing shared expenses. It offers an easy way to replace the hassle of carrying cash or tracking shared costs. 

Equipped with an easy-to-use interface, Venmo adopts a no-hassle system for processing payments. To start, you must create a Venmo account before linking your bank account or debit card to it. Once done, you can use the app to send and receive payments from anywhere and anytime. Thus making it a part of the must-have apps for iPhone list.  

Pros

  • Safe and secure interface 
  • Ideal for shared payments 
  • Instant transfers  

Cons

  •  No cons found

Price: Free  

Download  

Food and Travel apps

Embark on culinary adventures and navigate the world with ease using these essential food and travel apps for iPhone.

24. Google Maps – Best navigation app for iPhone

Google Maps comes in handy when you feel stuck in the nowhere land. The app shines as one of the most popular web-mapping services featuring the best of Google’s advanced technology. Simply enter your destination on the map and wait. The portal lays out the entire direction path for your destination and even narrates it turn-by-turn using the voice assistant.  

You can use this multipurpose app to access street maps, 360-degree panoramic views of streets and locations, and real-time traffic conditions. Perfect for exploring places. Furthermore, you get satellite imagery of most cities and towns worldwide, with a resolution of up to 15 cm. It even suggests the shortest route to your preferred locations. 

Pros

  • Easy-to-use interface  
  • Turn-by-turn guided directions 
  • In-app voice assistant  

Cons

  •  This can lead to difficult routes 

Price: Free  

Download  

25. Airbnb – Pocket-friendly staycations for travelers

Love traveling but low on budget? No worries! Airbnb is at your service. This popular accommodation service helps you find the best staycations at the most affordable prices. You can search for a good Airbnb, book your stay, get in touch with the host, make payments, and enjoy a comfy stay away from the hustle of everyday life. 

Pros

  • Easy-to-use interface  
  • Turn-by-turn guided directions 
  • In-app voice assistant  

Cons

  •  This can lead to difficult routes 

Price: Free  

Download  

26. GasBuddy – Never pay more for fuel and gas

Since we are here discussing the most essential apps for iPhone, it is obvious to mention the GasBuddy app. This mobile-friendly app feeds you with real-time gas prices at nearby stations, so you never have to pay an extra penny. Apart from this, GasBuddy has certain other essential features like a gas map for location data, fuel-saver tips, gas station reviews, etc. 

The portal also offers a debit card that can help you save up to 25 cents per gallon on gas. In addition, you can turn your daily purchases into free gas or complete challenges to earn juicy points. You can track your gas use and export the data for tax reimbursement. 

Pros

  • Easy-to-use interface  
  • Turn-by-turn guided directions 
  • In-app voice assistant  

Cons

  •  This can lead to difficult routes

Price: Free  

Download  

27. Waze – Explore with accurate navigation

Waze is the best navigation app for iPhone, with the biggest community-based live traffic. In this app, the local drivers update real-time traffic and route information about construction, road hazards, speed traps, etc., occasionally. So, plan your journey accordingly with dynamic routing to save time.  

Besides, you can find the cheapest gas along your route to save money. But you must have the internet to access the live map and interact with other drivers. I loved its compatibility with playing music and podcasts directly from the app. Besides, you can use it on your car’s display while driving with Apple CarPlay. 

Pros

  • Real-time traffic information 
  • Apple CarPlay compatibility 
  • Rerouting automation 

Cons

  • Ads on the screen create distractions

Price: Free 

Download  

You must read: Waze vs Google Maps: Which is the better navigation app?

28. OpenTable – Table bookings in your favorite diners

Spend time with your special someone in a perfect ambiance and delicious food. Try OpenTable. This well-known restaurant reservation app helps you find and book a table at your favorite restaurants, even during busy hours. In addition, the portal lets you browse menus, scan reviews, view your dining history, and more.   

The app allows you to make instant reservations to local restaurants and even fine-dining restaurants with limited access to visitors. You can get some fantastic discounts, free meals, and exclusive access to special invite events with OpenTable. The portal rewards users for making reservations, referring friends, and writing reviews. 

Pros

  • Instant reservations 
  • Full customizations allowed 
  • Offers juicy rewards 

Cons

  • Can be complicated when making reservations

Price: Free  

Download  

Health and Fitness apps

Embrace a healthier lifestyle with the best health and fitness apps for iPhone, designed to help you achieve your fitness goals and optimize your overall well-being.

29. MyFitnessPal – Calorie counter and health tracker

MyFitnessPal is your virtual trainer, health expert, and nutrition manager who keeps you motivated to achieve your fitness goals. It does this through a powerful combination of- physical workouts, daily step targets, meal charts, and positive motivation. You can create personalized plans and log food to track your eating habits.   

The portal gives you the calorie count with a simple scan of the food you plan to eat. Plus, the app houses a database of 500+ healthy recipes and 50 workout plans. There is a macro tracker that shows the breakdown of your food nutrients for better health management.    

Pros

  • Contains a water tracker 
  • A big community  
  • Easy food logging 

Cons

  •   Can be overwhelming

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $9.99) 

Download  

30. Nike Training Club – Holistic fitness for you 

Sometimes, our stressful work life spoils our gym routine. If you are a victim of this cruel reality, Nike Training Club is the perfect companion for you. Here, you get a variety of home workouts that you can do in a small space and in less time. Besides physical activities, NTC boasts a collection of yoga practices, guided meditation, and mindfulness.  

The portal houses several training programs to help you achieve your health goals without messing up your everyday life. In addition, NTC enables you to seek instant guidance on workouts, nutrition, mindfulness, rest, etc., from health experts. The portal has a dedicated section highlighting real stories about food. Don’t forget to check these best yoga apps for iPhone.  

Pros

  • User-friendly interface 
  • Pre-designed training programs  
  • Collection of at-home workouts

Cons

  • Limited features

Price: Free  

Download  

31. Period tracker period calendar – Never miss your dates

With the Period Tracker Period Calendar app, you don’t have to worry about keeping track of your period dates. Thanks to this period tracker that notifies you about the starting and ending dates of your next period cycle. In addition, it analyzes your period cycle to predict the most fertile days for getting pregnant naturally.   

You can also find a pill reminder, a birth control planner, and a due date calculator in this portal. Further, the pregnancy mode lets you track your baby’s weekly growth. In the case of abnormalities, you can hop on to the symptoms and tips section. 

Pros

  • Timely period alerts 
  • Ovulation tracker, pill reminder, etc.  
  • Instant guidance from experts

Cons

  • Can be improved

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.49) 

Download  

Lifestyle apps

Need some cool lifestyle solutions? Take a look at some of the best lifestyle apps for iPhone.

32. Pinterest – Find new ideas every day

Pinterest is one of the most popular websites for sharing and categorizing images you find online or in real life. You can create personal Pinterest boards to organize your favorite images into different categories. The collection can include pictures related to fashion, home décor, travel, arts and crafts, DIY ideas, food and drink, and more. You can even follow other users and purchase items via the attached link quickly.  

Pros

  • Virtual pinboard for all 
  • A diverse collection  
  • Free to use 

Cons

  • Can be overwhelming for some users

Price: Free  

Download  

33. Kickstarter – Best crowdfunding portal for iPhone

Do you want to be an investor? Kickstarter might be the help you were looking for. This crowdfunding platform has thousands of active projects belonging to different genres like films, music, games, technology, and more. Hop on to the portal to join other backers who share your vision or seek inspiration from them.  

Once you decide, you can delve deep into the project by reading descriptions, watching videos, and checking their rewards. Plus, the app gives you regular updates from the project creator and lets you track your spending.  

Pros

  • Virtual pinboard for all 
  • A diverse collection  
  • Free to use 

Cons

  • Can be overwhelming for some users

Price: Free

Download

Productivity apps

Boost your productivity with these essential apps for task management, note-taking, and time tracking.

34. Todoist – Plan your work like a pro

With Todoist, you get a simple yet efficient task manager and to-do list app. Its simple but intuitive interface helps you plan and organize your everyday tasks in seconds. The multiple project templates lessen your burden, helping you manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Here, you can get pre-designed packing lists, meeting agendas, accounting activities, etc.  

You can use Todoist to collaborate with your team, assign them tasks, leave comments, send voice notes, and attach important files. Plus, you can integrate Todoist with your calendar, voice assistant, Gmail, and other apps for a more comprehensive work experience. Less effort, more work, and you are sorted. 

Pros

  • Pre-designed templates 
  • Easy syncing across Apple devices 
  • Works with important apps  

Cons

  • No cons found

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $4.99) 

Download  

35. IFTTT – Automate your everyday tasks

If this, then that or IFTTT as you might know it- is one of the best iPhone apps to own in the present tech era. Designed to automate tasks, IFTTT thrives as a game-changer for those who love putting technology to use for doing their everyday tasks. The seamless, no-coding involved interface ensures you can enjoy instant workflow automation at work and home.  

The app supports over 800 renowned business and smart home apps and boasts 100,000 pre-built automation tasks. Simply select an automation type from the app or curate one from scratch per your interests. Also, you can hop on to our guide featuring the best productivity apps for iPhone.

Pros

  • Easily automates tasks 
  • 100,000 pre-built automation 
  • No coding needed  

Cons

  • Less reliable

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $3.99)

Download  

36. Dropbox- Secure backup of data  

If your devices are overflowing with files, it’s time you move to Dropbox. The syncing service lets you upload, store, and transfer photos, files, videos, documents, and others to its secure cloud storage. Once transferred, you can access the saved files from anywhere, even offline. FYI, the portal lets you view 175+ different file types without any special software.   

With Dropbox, you can scan documents, IDs, receipts, and photos using your iPhone camera and then convert them into easily shareable PDFs. The app helps you send files in the form of links to users without a Dropbox account. Moreover, you get 2TB of storage space with the free variant.

Pros

  • Auto-upload of files to cloud 
  • File sharing via links  
  • Scans and converts files into PDFs 
  • Free 2TB storage  

Cons

  • Security concerns

Price: Free  

Download  

Security apps

Shield your digital life with these apps for enhanced security, password management, and privacy.

37. Dashlane – Create secure passwords for data

Enjoy a safe iPhone experience with the Dashlane app. The password manager helps you create and store strong passwords for all your apps and websites. It analyzes your passcodes and gives recommendations for improvement. With multi-factor authentication, Dashlane adds another layer of safety to your precious accounts, data, and information.   

This robust portal scans the dark web for hacked passwords and personal data and immediately notifies you in the case of a breach. In addition, you can use Dashlane to share your passcodes and confidential information with friends without worrying about hacks. Plus, this security app for iPhone lets you store your notes, encrypt them, and protect them via a master password.   

Pros

  • All-in-one password manager 
  • Multi-factor authentication 
  • Safe password sharing  
  • Gives password recommendations 

Cons

  • Expensive
  • The free version limited to one device

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $3.49)

Download  

38. Signal – Your private messaging app  

Signal shines as one of the best messaging apps centered around privacy. The app boasts a simple interface that uses end-to-end encryption to keep your communication free from third-party intrusions. Feel free to send text/video messages and make voice/video calls, photos, videos, GIFs, documents, and files instantly and with no fees using this amazing platform. 

Here, you can hold group chats with up to 1,000 people and group calls with a maximum of 40 people. The app lets you control and manage your groups with customized admin permission settings. Plus, you can add video stories on Signal and watch them disappear after 24 hours of posting.  

Pros

  • Uses end-to-end encryption 
  • Supports group chats and calls 
  • Helps share files and documents  

Cons

  • Issues with notifications

Price: Free  

Download  

39. ExpressVPN – Easy access to safe browsing on iPhone

Make way for a secure and private browsing experience with ExpressVPN. The service helps you sail through geo-restrictions and unblock location-specific streaming portals for a flawless online streaming experience. You get blazing-fast speed and unlimited bandwidth to access your favorite content and apps from your iPhone.  

Through encryption, ExpressVPN offers easy connectivity to secure servers in 105 countries around the globe. Moreover, the app houses a robust password manager that improves the safety standards of your streaming sessions. You can create, store, and enter passwords, save credit card data, and get timely alerts to data threats. Also, here are some other efficient VPN services for iPhones you can surely give a shot.

Pros

  • Secure servers across 105 countries 
  • Superfast speed  
  • In-app password manager  

Cons

  • Limited features

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $12.99)

Download  

40. Duo Mobile – Safe logins from anywhere

The Duo Mobile app uses Duo Security’s two-factor authentication system to enhance the safety of your more critical logins. You can rely on this robust password manager to manage two-factor authentication for third-party apps and websites that use passcodes. If you deal in confidential data, Duo Mobile is an ideal iPhone app for you.   

A simple tap on your iPhone is all you need to allow logins from new devices on any of your accounts secured by this app. And the best part? The app is designed to work with Apple Watch, too, giving you full access to your ecosystem without any threats.   

Pros

  • Supports 2FA 
  • Boasts a simple interface 
  • Works with Apple Watch  

Cons

  • Requires regular iOS update

Price: Free  

Download  

Utility apps

To top things off, here are a few more handy apps that can improve your iPhone experience.

41. Unit Converter – Ideal for instant conversions

Not everyone loves dealing with numbers. If you are one of them, Unit Converter is for you. This online platform features 12 different categories and units to help you make instant conversions. You can use the app to convert currency, length, power, temperature, speed, time, weight-mass, fuel-milage, area, and data-computer data. Presently, the app supports 155 global currencies.  

Pros

  • Supports 2FA 
  • Boasts a simple interface 
  • Works with Apple Watch 

Cons

  • Requires regular iOS update

Price: Free

content.rendered:
iMessage boasts many unique features that set it apart from other messaging apps and gives an exclusive experience to iOS users. It lets you add fun, productivity, and style to your messaging experience. So whether you’re looking for a way to make your iMessage conversations more fun or productive, keep reading to find the best iMessage apps available on the App Store right now!

Table of Contents
  • 1. GIPHY – Best iMessage app for gif
  • 2. YouTube – Best for sharing videos and songs
  • 3. Venmo – Best for sending cash
  • 4. Google Maps – Best for sharing location
  • 5. JibJab – Best for greetings and cards
  • 6. iTranslate – Best for multilingual texting
  • 7. Open Table – Best for dining out
  • 8. Microsoft OneDrive – Best for sharing files
  • 9. Super Mario Run – Best iMessage stickers app
  • 10. Game Pigeon – Best iMessage game

1. GIPHY – Best iMessage app for gif

Memes and GIFs are the hallmarks of our times, and GIPHY is among the best free iMessage apps to make the most of them. It allows you to send your favorite GIFs in just a few seconds without the need to open the GIPHY app. No matter what the situation, GIPHY has a meme or gif to perfectly fit the purpose and bring a smile to your face.

I love the easy search function that lets me find an endless variety of animations related to any mood or topic. Moreover, you can also search through text and emojis to create and send custom GIFs. How cool is that!

Although you require a GIPHY account to save your favorite GIFs for future use, the fun makes it worth it! After all, a picture is worth a thousand words, and this has never been truer than in this age of visual communication! 

Price: Free

Download

2. YouTube – Best for sharing videos and songs

I love sharing fun videos or songs with friends and family, and the YouTube extension for iMessage makes it super easy. As long as you have the YouTube app on your iPhone, you can use it within iMessage to search and send videos without leaving your chat. 

This saves the effort of having to go into YouTube and copy the video URL into a chat message. I use this extension innumerable times to express how I’m feeling and share new song discoveries with friends and family. Try it for yourself, and I’m sure you’ll enjoy it. After all, many times, music speaks so much better than just words. 

Price: Free

Download

3. Venmo – Best for sending cash

Venmo makes it easy and quick to send and receive cash from anyone. It gets even more convenient with the iMessage extension. It lets you send or request cash without leaving your conversation.

Further, you can also check your Venmo balance from within iMessage and change the privacy settings for a payment. It’s a must-have if you’re a frequent user of this payment app! However, you’ll have to open the Venmo app to do more, like transfer your balance or view your transaction history. 

Price: Free

Download

4. Google Maps – Best for sharing location

There are innumerable times when you might need to share your location with someone. The Google Maps iMessage extension makes this a breeze. 

It shares your exact coordinates so that friends can know where you are and your ETA. it also works great as a safety feature when you’re out and about and want to let someone know how to find you in case of emergencies. It’s quick, convenient, and accurate, a must-have for everyone! 

Price: Free

Download

5. JibJab – Best for greetings and cards

Want to step up your gifs and add your face to make them more personalized? Here’s a super fun iMessage app that’s designed for just that. You can snap a selfie and create hilarious GIFs, greetings, and e-cards that are a breeze to send from within iMessage. 

Further, you can even add the faces of friends, family, or your pet to create funny and adorable ecards, dance videos, and gifs.

I love the sheer variety of ecards and fun greetings it offers for various occasions, including Halloween, Christmas, Valentine’s Day, Thanksgiving, St. Patrick’s Day, and more. The collection of GIFs and videos is also updated quite frequently to keep things fresh! 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99)

Download

6. iTranslate – Best for multilingual texting

If you love traveling as much as I do or simply need a translation tool, iTranslate is pretty nifty. It seamlessly integrates into iMessage to translate text into over 100 different languages.

All you’ve got to do is select the output language and then type your message. The app will handle the rest and give you a translated message to send to your foreign contacts.

However, you will need a Pro subscription to do more with the app, such as accessing it offline. It’s pretty useful if you’re frequently abroad because you can use it to translate menus and signs using your phone camera too.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $4.99) 

Download

7. Open Table – Best for dining out

Open Table is my go-to app to find and book a great place to eat out. It makes it incredibly convenient to find amazing restaurants near you and reserve a table. The iMessage extension of this app helps you quickly invite others to wherever you’re going. 

This helps everyone stay on the same page and know what time you’re supposed to meet. Moreover, the person can choose to accept or decline the invitation, so you know their availability at any time. No more going and back forth endlessly discussing plans. Just fix a place on Open Table, exchange an invite over iMessage, and you’re sorted. 

Price: Free

Download

8. Microsoft OneDrive – Best for sharing files

Here’s another one of my favorite and most used iMessage apps. OneDrive makes it so easy to share files right from my chats without needing any other third-party apps. 

You can share anything from your OneDrive account and conveniently search your files to find the right one. Once selected, you can type out a message to explain it and simply send it across.

The recipient will get a link to view or edit the document or photo you send in the OneDrive app on their device. Of course, this requires that both you and the recipients have OneDrive accounts.

Price: Free

Download

9. Super Mario Run – Best iMessage stickers app

Any conversation is always better with stickers! And among my favorite iMessage sticker apps is this adorable one from Super Mario Run. Super Mario was a defining part of my childhood and is one of the most popular game franchises most people relate to. 

These stickers capture that with iconic stickers of characters and props from the game. These are sure to add a dash of fun to your chats and make them more memorable. Moreover, you can add stickers to photos to add a bit of Mario to your life! Pretty cool! 

Price: Free

Download

10. Game Pigeon – Best iMessage game

What could be more fun than playing a game or two while chatting with your friends? Enter GamePigeon – one of the best iMessage game apps! It has a collection of many fun multiplayer games that will keep you entertained. These include 8-Ball, Mini Golf, Basketball, Chess, Sea Battle, Tanks, and more. 

The graphics are fun and colorful, and all the games I tried work well. Moreover, the developer keeps it well-updated, and new ones are added frequently. It also supports multiple languages like French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, and Traditional Chinese. 

Price: Free

Download

Keep messaging!

I hope this article gave you all the information you need about iMessage apps on iPhone. Let me know in the comments below if you have any questions!

title.rendered: Best iPad drawing apps for kids in 2026

content.rendered:
There’s probably nothing as creative as drawing, sketching, or painting. Kids who have the inclination to draw, sketch, and paint must be encouraged as much as possible to continue. This is one of the coolest things about humans: our creativity. With technology helping us be more creative in our lives, you’ll find dozens of great iPad Pro drawing Apps for kids. We tried to narrow down to five of the best drawing apps on the iPad (for kids). Check out and tell us about your favorites too.

Table of Contents
  • Best iPad drawing apps for kids
    • 1. SketchPro: Paint and Draw Art – Editor's Choice
    • 2. Drawing Desk
    • 3. Tayasui Sketches
    • 4. Inspire Pro
    • 5. Art Rage

Best iPad drawing apps for kids

No matter what level of artist your kid is, these apps would be a great help. So, without further ado, here are the best drawing apps for iPad and Apple Pencil.

1. SketchPro: Paint and Draw Art – Editor’s Choice

Thanks to the robust outlay of features adorning this amazing app, SketchPro will likely be your ideal companion in the digital art space, whether you are a professional artist or a new art enthusiast. Can you believe that there are more than 100 different types of brushes on SketchPro? This includes specialized brushes for sketching, painting, Airbrushing, roller brushing, calligraphy, and more. Phew! 

By leveraging AI, SketchPro takes your digital art experience to the next level. For instance, the AI-colorize feature accepts your color suggestions/hints and then fills colors accordingly. Moreover, the OBG remove icon lets you remove objects/backgrounds at your will. There is a magic eraser, too, to remove the imperfections in your art piece in seconds. Now, this comes in handy for professionals like graphic designers, digital artists, comic book creators, illustrators, etc.

SketchPro features a big stack of smart shapes for a hassle-free drawing. While Basic Shapes are accessible to all, you will need a subscription to use other shape categories like Call Outs, Chairs, Flow Charts, etc. Plus, the assisted drawing option works like a guide to help your little ones give wings to their imagination. You can choose your canvas and start drawing, simple.

Regarding text, this iPhone and iPad-friendly app lets you play with different font styles, sizes, spacing, opacity, texture, and colors. In addition, you get unlimited layers for creating stunning digital art. Feel free to duplicate, merge, or rasterize layers for a smooth run. Impressive filter features like Motion Blur, Gaussian Blur, AR Facepaint, custom Canvas, etc., are enough to make your kid fall in love with SketchPro.

SketchPro lets you save every drawing to work on them at your convenience. Plus, the app offers easy syncing between iPads and iPhones and Cloud Backup Support for a promising workflow.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $39.99)

Download

2. Drawing Desk

“Drawing Desk” has been designed to entertain all groups of people. It features four modes: a kids desk, a sketch desk, a double desk, and a photo desk. Kids desk allows kids to draw comfortably with stickers, stamps as well as several effects.

Sketch desk lets you draw using the creative brush, watercolor, and pencil. Live brush and stroke effects enable you to enhance the quality of your photos. Thanks to 3D brushes, color palettes, and stamps, it makes doodling such an excellent experience.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $4.99)

Download

3. Tayasui Sketches

Top-quality tools are one of the main secrets of impressive drawing. Tayasui Sketches, with 20 highly user-friendly tools, is an ideal app for sketching adorable drawings. The watercolor wet brushes, editor, and color eyedropper give the decisive edge to drawing.

The pressure stylus support makes your drawing a fabulous experience as you discover more innovative brushes while using Apple Pencil. It lets you organize your drawings in folders which you can personalize as per your need.

Price: Free (Pro version available at $7.99)

Download

4. Inspire Pro

I’m really charmed by the precision with which this app lets you draw. It doesn’t matter whether you have tons of experience or want to have a good grip on creating an appreciable design; Inspire Pro will ideally fit your needs. The drawing app has a colossal library of a number of top-quality brushes, which have been divided into different sets.

You can use all the brushes as wet, dry or erase. There are 20 settings to let you customize the brushes. Even better, you can create a canvas of any size up to 16K on your iPad Pro.

Price: $9.99

Download

5. Art Rage

With ArtRage, the drawing would come naturally to you. Adorable simulation of real paint on iPad not only boosts user experience but also augments the quality of the drawing. Endowed with a range of handy tools such as Google pen, glitter tube, flood fill, and crayon, it enormously assists you in creating excellent art.

The present support lets you save settings to use them later. There are tons of layers having photoshop standard blend mode, opacity as well as visibility controls to give your drawing the killer punch.

Price: $2.99

Download

So which app are you using?

I know these iPad Pro drawing apps have impressed you. But which one has received the maximum vote from you? Are any of your favorite drawing apps not included in this list? Do let me know that in the comments.

Read more:

  • ArtWorkout: Best app to learn how to draw on iPad
